title: OpenPIV/openpiv-python: OpenPIV-Python
description: OpenPIV consists of Python and compiled acceleration modules for scripting and executing the analysis of particle image velocimetry (PIV) image pairs. It features a high-performance dual-backend engine combining multi-threaded Rust acceleration with pure Python/SciPy reference routines.
